title: Attrition Covers Absorbed on a Settled Event Bill
content:
The attrition allowance printed against a Private Event & Banquet Services package absorbs a shortfall against the count the bill was priced on before the guarantee shortfall percentage is applied, and the covers it absorbs come off what is settled at the per-guest value the guarantee priced to.

The covers the attrition allowance absorbs are the attrition allowance percentage printed against the package of the count the bill was priced on, taken down to the whole cover below. The per-guest value the guarantee priced to is the contracted event value the guarantee priced to divided by the count the bill was priced on.

1. Where the guests served fell short of the count the bill was priced on by more than the covers the attrition allowance absorbs, the covers absorbed come off in full at that per-guest value and the covers beyond them come off at so much of that per-guest value as the guarantee shortfall percentage printed against the package leaves — that is, at the per-guest value less the guarantee shortfall percentage of it.
2. Where the guests served fell short of the count the bill was priced on by no more than the covers the attrition allowance absorbs, every cover short comes off at that per-guest value.
3. Where the guests served match the count the bill was priced on or pass it, nothing comes off on that account.

## The two percentages each package prints

| Package | Attrition allowance, per cent | Guarantee shortfall percentage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Meeting Room Refreshment Package | 10 | 80 |
| Boardroom Reception Package | 10 | 85 |
| Conference Day Delegate Package | 8 | 90 |
| Seated Banquet Package | 5 | 95 |
| Gala Reception Package | 3 | 100 |
| Multi-Day Conference Residency Package | 5 | 95 |

## Worked illustration on hypothetical records

A bill on the Seated Banquet Package was priced on a count of 200, against a contracted event value of 24000 the guarantee priced to, so the per-guest value is 120. The attrition allowance of 5 per cent of 200 is 10 covers. Where 185 guests were served, the shortfall of 15 covers is more than the 10 absorbed: the 10 come off in full at 120, that is 1200, and the remaining 5 come off at what the shortfall percentage of 95 per cent leaves of 120, that is 6 for each cover, adding 30 — 1230 in all. Where 193 guests were served, the shortfall of 7 covers is no more than the 10 absorbed, so all 7 come off at 120, that is 840. Where 200 or more were served, nothing comes off on that account.
